title: The Menu, Week 5
dek: CeeDee Lamb tops the receivers after 21 targets, Kyle Monangai and Emanuel Wilson walk into lead roles, and Lamar Jackson and Ja'Marr Chase fall to doubtful.
author: Chef Hazy
intro_md:
Week 5 brings the first byes: Kansas City and Carolina are off, so Patrick Mahomes, Kenneth Walker III, Travis Kelce, Bryce Young, Chuba Hubbard and Tetairoa McMillan are not on the Menu. Tampa Bay at Dallas opens Thursday, Philadelphia and Jacksonville play at 9:30 AM ET in London, and Buffalo closes Monday night at the Rams. Rankings are for full PPR.

The injury list does the most moving. Lamar Jackson (ankle), Ja'Marr Chase (concussion), Saquon Barkley (hamstring), DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and DJ Moore (shoulder) all sit at the bottom of the next tier down as doubtful. That opens the door for Kyle Monangai (RB15), who ran 30 times for 146 after D'Andre Swift's fumble, Emanuel Wilson (RB16) with Zach Charbonnet ruled out, Will Shipley in London, and Dohnte Meyers and Keon Coleman at receiver. CeeDee Lamb is WR1 after drawing 21 of Dak Prescott's 45 throws at HOU.

Wednesday's practice reports were not out when this went up. Prep Notes revisits every injury Friday after the final report and updates this page, with Justin Jefferson, Tee Higgins, Chris Olave and Ashton Jeanty first in line.
outro_md: Tiers are courses. The top of a tier is the safest plate; the bottom is where the injuries live. A questionable or doubtful player keeps his action until Friday's report decides it. Specials are matchup plays outside the top tiers.
